The transmission inner function changes `p = var.loc[:, idx] * efficiency[idx]` to `p = -var.sel(name=idx) * efficiency[idx]`, unconditionally negating the expression even under legacy semantics. Thus a branch with nonzero flow and nonzero port efficiency can report the opposite value for the same input; the default or multiindex snapshot setting does not prevent this change.
